employee_number: ---IMPORT INSTRUCTIONS (delete this section before importing)---
FIELD DEFINITIONS:
- employee_number: Your employee ID (must match employees import)
- work_date: Date worked (YYYY-MM-DD format)
- start_time: Clock in time (HH:MM in 24-hour format)
- end_time: Clock out time (HH:MM in 24-hour format)
- break_minutes: Unpaid break time in minutes (integer)
- hours: Total hours worked (decimal
- overtime_hours: Hours at OT rate (included in total hours)
- hourly_rate: Override rate (leave 0 to use employee default)
- description: Work description
- status: pending | approved | rejected
- notes: Additional notes
HOW TO USE:
1. Enter your employee_number in each row
2. Fill in times for each day worked
3. Calculate hours (end - start - break)
4. OT is hours over 8/day or 40/week
5. Delete this instruction section before importing
6. Import via ATLVS > Settings > Data Import > Time Entries
